secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Google OAuth client ID used for shopper sign-in: Google Cloud Console -> APIs & Services -> Credentials -> OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Web application). A real value ends with '.apps.googleusercontent.com'. The value stored so far is a short placeholder, so Google answers 'invalid_client' and sign-in cannot complete.

secrets.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret paired with GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, from the same Google Cloud Console OAuth client. A real value starts with 'GOCSPX-' and is about 35 characters. The value stored so far is a placeholder.

secrets.name: SESSION_SECRET
secrets.description: Signing key for the signed sign-in cookie.
